review_candidates.company: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Customer Experience Management (CXM) Specialist is responsible for building and leading KAUSTIT’s customer experience measurement and improvement program. This role ensures IT services are evaluated, reported, and continuously improved based on user insights, positioning IT as a trusted, user-centric partner to the KAUST community. The role requires a rare combination of analytical skill, technical capability, and stakeholder engagement , ensuring that customer voice is not only heard but acted upon at the highest levels of decision-making. The role also supports the team’s Service Performance Management function by providing data analytics expertise in KPI reporting for the department. Major Accountabilities Customer Experience Strategy & Measurement Design and implement IT’s CXM framework, including CSAT, CES,and NPS. Manage platforms and systems that collect, track, and analyze user feedback. Establish feedback loops that translate measurement into improvement initiatives. Governance &Reporting Provide regular CXM reporting to the CIO,IT Leadership, and Strategic Management Office (SMO). Ensure transparency of service satisfaction levels through dashboards and scorecards. Define escalation processes with the IT Helpdesk, ensuring user complaints and service failures are systematically addressed. Service Improvement Partner with IT service owners to translate user insights into action plans. Track adoption and satisfaction improvements resulting from CXM initiatives. Collaborate with team members in UI/UX, Technology Experience Enablement, Engagement, Change Management to address systemic service issues. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the advocate of the KAUST user community within IT. Facilitate workshops, surveys, and focus groups to deepen understanding of user needs. Support institutional reporting by providing consolidated customer experience metrics. CXM Platform Management Manage the full lifecycle of the CXM platform, including survey design and deployment (CSAT, CES, NPS), workflow configuration, integrations with IT systems (ITSM, service catalog, identity tools), and ongoing platform administration, reliability and governance. Build dashboards, automated reports, and analytics pipelines that consolidate feedback data, apply AI-driven insights (text mining, sentiment analysis), and provide real-time visibility into user experience trends and service performance. Ensure data quality, privacy compliance, and seamless data flow across all CXM touchpoints, maintaining a scalable and user-centric platform that supports continuous improvement initiatives. Dimensions of the Role Scope: Owns all IT customer experience measurement and reporting mechanisms. Decision-Making Authority: Defines CXM metrics, platforms, and reporting standards. Institutional Impact: Directly influences user trust in IT services and overall IT reputation. Reporting: Regularly presents findings to CIO and IT leadership, with downstream impact on service investment and prioritization. Key Stakeholders Internal:CIO, IT Leadership, IT Service Owners,IT Helpdesk. University-Wide: Faculty, researchers, students, and staff who rely on IT services. External:Vendors providing CXM tools or benchmarking services. SFIA Skills(Indicative Levels) CNSL – Consultancy (Level 5): Advises service owners on improving user satisfaction. MEAS – Measurement (Level 5): Defines and manages metrics for service quality. USUP – Customer Service Support (Level5): Oversees complaint resolution and escalation frameworks. DTAN – Data Analysis (Level 5): Interprets feedback and service data into actionable insights. RLMT – Stakeholder Relationship Management (Level 4–5):Builds trust by communicating user insights clearly to leadership. Performance Measures Delivery of accurate and timely CXM reports to CIO and SMO. Improvement in CSAT, CES,and NPS scores across IT services. Reduction in unresolved complaints and escalations. Documented service improvements linked directly to CXM data. Positive recognition of ITs responsiveness and accountability by KAUST stakeholders. Personal Requirements Competencies Customer Experience & Service Excellence Strong understanding of CX frameworks (CSAT, CES, NPS)and user-centric service principles. Ability to convert feedback and data into actionable service improvements. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills. Data &Analytics Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative feedback using dashboards and analytics tools. Skilled in identifying trends and insights through structured analysis and data storytelling. Working knowledge of statistical concepts (sampling, weighting, margins of error) to ensure accurate analysis of CXM data. Supports the team’s service performance management function by providing expertise in analytics and KPI reporting at a department level CXM Platform & Technical Skills Hands-on experience with CXM platforms (survey building, workflow configuration, integrations). Ability to use AI tools,text analytics, and sentiment analysis to deepen insights. Familiarity with ITSM systems, APIs, and dataflows. Process &Governance Knowledge of ITIL and service improvement practices. Strong documentation, structure, and reporting discipline. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Customer Experience, Quality Assurance, Data Analytics, or related field. ITIL certification preferred; CX or analytics certifications are a plus. Experience 6+ Years of experience in CXM, service excellence, analytics, Service quality, performance management or IT service management. Experience with CXM platforms (Qualtrics, Medallia, etc.)and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau). Experience in technology, highereducation, or service-driven environments preferred.

review_candidates.title: Account Executive
review_candidates.description: Appear is building the infrastructure that helps brands get cited by AI: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini. We're early, we're growing fast, and we need someone who can sell a category that didn't exist two years ago. Context Search is shifting. When someone asks ChatGPT which law firm, clinic, or software to use, the brands that get cited win the business, and most companies have no idea whether they're showing up. Appear fixes that. We measure AI visibility, identify the gaps, and build the content infrastructure to close them. You'll be selling a problem most prospects don't know they have yet, which makes this role genuinely hard, and genuinely interesting. Tasks Full-cycle new business: from first touch to signed contract. You own the number. Build and work a targeted pipeline across 2–3 verticals where AI visibility ROI is clearest (legal, healthcare, financial services, professional services). Run discovery that surfaces the problem before pitching the product. Prospects rarely know their AI citation rate. You'll show them, then show them what it costs. Lead demos, business case presentations, and commercial negotiations with senior stakeholders up to C-level. Work closely with the founders on positioning, pricing, and deal structure. Your input shapes how we sell. Feed market and objection intelligence directly into product and marketing. No intermediary, no lost signal. Use AI natively: account research, call prep, pipeline management, follow-up drafting. We expect this to be table stakes, not a differentiator. Requirements 3+ years in an AE role, senior BDR, or full-cycle role in B2B SaaS. Comfortable with commercial conversations. You can discuss pricing, ROI, and contract terms without deferring to sales. Strong at asking the right questions in client meetings, not just presenting. Genuinely curious about AI and how it's changing search. Clients will ask hard questions and you need to hold your own. Organised and proactive: you manage your book of business systematically, not reactively. Fluent in English. Spanish or other European languages are a plus for our client base. Nice to have Background in SEO, content marketing, or digital agency work. You'll speak your clients' language immediately. Experience managing accounts across legal, healthcare, financial services, or professional services verticals. Familiarity with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM for account tracking and renewal management. You've been an early AE or BDR hire before and understand what it means to build the function as you run it. Real category upside. GEO is where SEO was in 2004. You're early enough to matter. Founders in the room. Direct access to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and GTM. No bureaucracy between you and decisions. We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone who looks at a category that barely exists, sees the opportunity, and wants to be the person who figured out how to sell it.

We are seeking a Technical Customer Support Officer to join our support team and provide knowledgeable, practical assistance to our customers. About the role You will provide day-to-day technical and product support by telephone, email and screen sharing. You will investigate and diagnose issues, guide customers through solutions, and ensure support requests are managed efficiently. You will work across software products for both saleyards and livestock producers, supporting our current on-premises systems in networked environments, and the future roll-out of next generation cloud applications. You will also help customers connect hardware including RFID readers, weigh scales and other devices used in the production, care and sale of livestock. Your responsibilities will include: Responding to customer support requests in a timely and knowledgeable manner. Investigating and resolving software, network and hardware-related issues. Providing Level 2 technical support across our software platforms. Installing, configuring and updating software on customer networks. Escalating complex issues to the development team or management when required. Documenting solutions and maintaining internal knowledge base content. Assisting with the testing of new features and product updates. Identifying recurring issues and opportunities to improve systems and processes. Advocating for customers by helping translate their operational needs into clear, actionable requirements. Participating in an after-hours on-call roster. The role may also include customer site visits, field events and other opportunities to develop a broader understanding of our customers and the livestock industry. About you You will be a capable problem-solver who can communicate technical information clearly and patiently. You will be comfortable managing competing priorities while taking ownership of customer issues through to resolution. Ideally, you will have: At least two years’ experience in customer service, customer support or a similar role. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. A sound understanding of IT environments, including networks and client hardware. Strong technical, analytical and problem-solving skills. Good organisational, ticket management and time management skills. The ability to work effectively with customers, support staff and software developers. An undergraduate qualification in IT or a related discipline. Experience with livestock software, agricultural technology or data collection in the livestock industry would be highly regarded. Why join Outcross Systems? This is a varied role where your work will have a direct impact on customers and product development. You will gain exposure to software support, customer operations and livestock technology while working collaboratively across several areas of the business. How to apply Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant technical support experience, approach to customer service, and interest in the role. A right to work in Australia is required.
